question: One-third of a jouney is covered at a rate of 40 km/h, one-fourth at the rate of 35 km/h, and the rest at the rate of 45 km/h. The average speed for the whole journey (in km/h) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume **Total Distance** as LCM of denominators (3, 4) multiplied by a scaling factor × 1200 units.

**Total Distance** = 1200 km.

**Total Time** = (400/40) + (300/35) + (500/45) = 10 + 60/7 + 100/9 = 10 + (540 + 700)/63 = 10 + 1240/63 = 1870/63 hours.

**Average Speed** = 1200 ÷ (1870/63) = (1200 × 63)/187 = 7560/187 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 7560/187 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Distance 1** (d₁) = 1/3, **Speed 1** (v₁) = 40 km/h

**Distance 2** (d₂) = 1/4, **Speed 2** (v₂) = 35 km/h

**Distance 3** (d₃) = 1 − (1/3 + 1/4) = 1 − 7/12 = 5/12, **Speed 3** (v₃) = 45 km/h

**Formula Used:**

**Average Speed** = **Total Distance** / **Total Time**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/987dbbc257476969dae00e5752e39014c97e5f5a1893aee5a1a1e9928211862d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Time = (D/3 ÷ 40) + (D/4 ÷ 35) + (5D/12 ÷ 45)

⇒ Total Time = D/120 + D/140 + D/108

⇒ Total Time = D × (1/120 + 1/140 + 1/108)

⇒ LCM of (120, 140, 108) = 7560

⇒ Total Time = D × (63 + 54 + 70)/7560 = D × 187/7560

⇒ Average Speed = D / (187D/7560) = 7560/187 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 7560/187 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Equal Distances

If two equal distances are covered at speeds x and y, then **Average Speed** = 2xy / (x + y). For three equal distances, 3xyz / (xy + yz + zx).

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in the **same direction**, relative speed is the difference (u − v). In **opposite directions**, it is the sum (u + v).</p
